name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 7 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2025-07-14, at wavelengths from 0.85 to 4.22 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
